messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Huh?!{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 04 00} From {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}?
That's kinda weird.

{07 00 00}Well, I guess it isn't a 
completely unpleasant 
surprise, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}I wonder what it says?
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Ah?!{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 04 00} {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} käest?
See on kuidagi imelik.

{07 00 00}Noh, vist pole see päris
ebameeldiv
üllatus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Huvitav, mis seal kirjas?

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 0a 00} You're seriously 
telling me {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}sent me this letter?
{07 14 00}And you delivered it to me
by hand?{01 00 00 05 00} I can't say I saw
this one comin'!
{07 00 00}Well then, {01 00 00 05 00}I guess the only
thing left to do is read
it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa ütled tõsiselt,
et {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 00}saatis mulle selle kirja?
{07 14 00}Ja sa tõid selle mulle
käsitsi?{01 00 00 05 00} Ei saa öelda, et
ma seda ette nägin!
{07 00 00}Noh siis, {01 00 00 05 00}vist ainus, mis
üle jääb, on see läbi
lugeda, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whaaaaa? {01 00 00 0a 00}It's a letter from
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}And you actually
got off your rear to
deliver the letter?
I'd say I was flabbergasted,
but that word is kinda
stupid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Miiiida? {01 00 00 0a 00}See on kiri
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} käest! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Ja sa tõesti
ajasid end püsti ja
tõid kirja kohale?
Ütleksin, et olen rabatud,
aga see sõna on kuidagi
rumal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
